description.zh: 宫城藏王狐狸村坐落于宫城县白石市的山林间，是日本最著名的野生动物接触型主题公园。园内有约100只日本狐狸自由漫步，游客可近距离观察乃至抱抱狐狸（需满足指定要求）。冬季积雪背景下白色狐狸穿梭林间，是全球最广泛传播的日本冬季摄影题材之一。
description.en: Zaō Fox Village in Shiroishi, Miyagi Prefecture, is Japan's most famous animal-encounter park. Around 100 free-roaming foxes can be observed at close range — and sometimes held (subject to conditions). The snow-covered winter setting, with white foxes moving through the forest, has become one of Japan's most-shared winter photography subjects worldwide.

location.zh: 宫城县白石市福冈八宮峯（藏王山麓）
location.en: Fukuoka Hachinomiya, Shiroishi City, Miyagi Prefecture

zh: 约100只自由漫步的日本狐狸，分布于多处圈养区与半开放区
冬季雪景：白雪覆盖的山林与狐狸相互映衬，是日本最广为流传的冬季摄影题材之一
抱抱体验（有条件）：特定时段可在工作人员协助下近距离接触和抱起狐狸
en: ~100 free-roaming Japanese foxes in multiple enclosures ranging from fenced areas to semi-open zones
Winter snowscape: foxes amid snowy mountain forest — one of Japan's most-shared winter photography subjects
Holding experience (conditional): at designated times and with staff supervision, visitors can hold foxes

admission.zh: 约1,000日元；抱抱体验另收费

tips.zh: 最近车站为东北新干线白石蔵王站，需乘出租车约20分钟（无直达公共交通）。1—2月雪季是最佳参观时期，但需注意道路积雪状况。
tips.en: The nearest station is Shiroishi-Zaō on the Tohoku Shinkansen; take a taxi ~20 minutes (no direct public bus). January–February snow season is the most atmospheric — check road conditions.

description.zh: 「御釜」是宫城·山形两县交界的藏王山火山口湖，以湖水随气候和光线变化呈现翠绿色、祖母绿乃至蔚蓝色而获得「五色湖」之美名。湖面海拔1,548米，夏季由藏王エコーライン（回声公路）可驾车直达火山口畔，是东北地区最独特的地质奇观。
description.en: Okama ('the Pot') is a volcanic crater lake on the Miyagi–Yamagata border within Zaō, renowned for its waters that shift from jade green to emerald to blue depending on weather and light — earning the name 'Goshiki-numa' (Five-Colour Lake). At 1,548 m elevation, accessible by car via the Zaō Echo Line in summer, it is one of Tōhoku's most remarkable geological wonders.

location.zh: 宫城县刈田郡藏王町（宫城·山形县境）

zh: 五色湖：湖水颜色随天候瞬息万变，晴天呈翠绿色，阴天可能呈银蓝或祖母绿
藏王刈田岳展望台：步行约5分钟可到达比御釜更高的展望台，全景俯瞰火山口
藏王エコーライン：全长约26公里的高原公路，沿途经过多处雪壁（积雪可达10米）
en: Five-Colour Lake: the crater water shifts between jade green, silver-blue and emerald with every change in weather
Zaō Kariyata-dake observation point: a 5-minute walk above Okama for full panoramic crater views
Zaō Echo Line: ~26 km highland road with snow-wall corridors up to 10 m high in May

admission.zh: 停车场收费约700日元；湖畔参观免费

tips.zh: 藏王エコーライン通常11月上旬至4月下旬关闭（降雪期）。最佳参观时间为5月（雪壁季节）或夏季晴天。从山形或宫城方向驾车均可进入。
tips.en: Zaō Echo Line is closed from early November to late April (snow season). Best visited in May for the snow walls or on a clear summer day. Access by car from either the Yamagata or Miyagi side.
